objective.text: Handle decryption failure as invalid protected data rather than accepting the original ciphertext as plaintext.

difficulty.rationale: Prevent a compatibility fallback from accepting data whose protection could not be verified.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A protected preference cookie fails decryptString. A proposed catch returns the original cookie value as if it were trusted plaintext. The application supports only encrypted cookies. What should the review require?

options.text: Base64-decode the original value and trust any printable output.
options.rationale: Encoding and printability do not verify the protected value.
options.misconception: Encoding and printability do not verify the protected value.

options.text: Reject or discard the invalid protected value and apply an explicit safe default.
options.rationale: A decryption failure means the value was not successfully authenticated/decrypted; treating the supplied bytes as trusted plaintext bypasses the protection.

options.text: Keep the fallback whenever the original bytes form valid JSON.
options.rationale: JSON syntax does not establish authenticity under the required encrypted-cookie contract.
options.misconception: JSON syntax does not establish authenticity under the required encrypted-cookie contract.

options.text: Catch only a generic Exception and continue with the original value.
options.rationale: Changing the catch type does not repair the unsafe acceptance policy.
options.misconception: Changing the catch type does not repair the unsafe acceptance policy.
